question: What is the algorithm used to create word embeddings?
title: Shared Task: Lexical Semantic Change Detection in German
answer_rationale: Text 9 states that the overall best-performing model is Skip-Gram with orthogonal alignment and cosine distance (SGNS + OP + CD). Text 6 also notes that most teams use SGNS + OP + CD as their base architecture, and Text 1, 3, 8 further confirm its usage in various teams. This indicates SGNS + OP + CD is the dominant algorithm used for creating word embeddings in the context of the retrieved documents.
